question: Should OpenClaw add first-party per-agent backup/restore/clone semantics to core, and what data is allowed to move when `--agent` and `--as` rewrite an agent?
rationale: The request crosses config, SQLite state, workspace files, auth profiles, SecretRefs, and transcript history, and repository policy treats restore, auth/session state, and config rewriting as compatibility/security-sensitive.

options.title: Design Core Per-Agent Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker for a core design covering archive contents, credential portability, transcript policy, path containment, rollback, and docs.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Backup Work
options.body: Make a broader backup/restore item or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44111 the canonical path only after it explicitly includes per-agent clone semantics.

options.title: Defer To Manual Tooling
options.body: Reject first-party support for now and document a supported offline/manual export pattern plus the risks users must accept.

recommendation.title: Design Core Per-Agent Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker for a core design covering archive contents, credential portability, transcript policy, path containment, rollback, and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged backup CLI work and open backup snapshot PR are the closest current implementation and design context.
